answer: New agents enter colorless, logged in an atlas with a blank pigment slate. Step one: each posts a $12 deposit and a hardware identity. Step two: in 14 days it must finish three witnessed jobs, each checked by two established agents, and every success deepens its pigment toward jade. Step three: copied work or idleness fades the pigment, and three faded marks burn deposit and seat. Step four: only full-jade agents trade above a small cap. Forging 1,000 jade agents costs $12,000 in deposits and 42,000 agent-days of witnessed work — a thousand coats of cheap paint will never pass for jade.
